title: Standard Curve Dilutions with CSV File
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Download the Serial Dilutions Excel Spreadsheet Template (.XLSX), edit the values for your standard curve, save the file as .CSV, and upload the CSV to the protocol.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect an Opentrons 24‑tube rack with Eppendorf 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock Snap‑cap tubes, a NEST 96‑well PCR plate (100 µL full skirt), and Opentrons 300 µL tip racks.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the tube rack, PCR plate, and tip rack on the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) in the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input any required protocol parameters in the OT App interface as prompted.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the deck, labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (use calibration tips as described in the support articles).

steps.title: Execute serial dilution steps
steps.instruction: The robot will iterate through each row of the CSV and perform the following actions for each dilution:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 44.5 µL of Diluent into intermediate well Int1 (Well A1).
Transfer 5.5 µL from Stock1 into Int1.
Mix Int1 3 times, then perform a blow‑out, touch the tip to the side of the well, and discard the tip.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
